name: headroom
description: A local-first brain-budget meter pooled across every local AI agent. I need a reset.

interface.shortDescription: Your AI has a usage limit. So do you.
interface.longDescription: I need a reset. A local-first, entertainment-only brain-budget meter that pools every local AI agent (Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Antigravity/Gemini, WorkBuddy) into one daily budget, with a Windows system-tray display, optional desktop orb, meme moods, and English/Chinese UI. Discovers each agent's own local history; per-agent hooks are optional. Mock scoring or a local Laya service; cloud Jev API integration is not implemented.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $headroom to show my remaining playful headroom.
